head: iPhone Duo 2 rumors: Face ID is Apple's top priority, says Gurman
dek: Apple has iPhone Duo 2 prototypes with Face ID on the outer screen, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, but he isn't sure it will be ready in time. Apple hasn't confirmed anything about a second Duo.
details: Gurman says Apple's two priorities for the next Duo are Face ID and an Action button, with Face ID first. The Action button may come as a software option for Camera Control that lets you swap the press-and-hold shortcut for an app you choose. If Face ID misses the Duo 2, he expects it on an iPhone Duo 3 in 2028. Over the next couple of generations Apple also wants a telephoto camera and a thinner, lighter phone.
where: Rumor for the iPhone Duo 2, expected next fall; not confirmed by Apple
means: If you're deciding whether to buy the first iPhone Duo or wait, Face ID on the next one is reported but not certain.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Today's Duo unlocks with Touch ID in its side button.
thumb_words: IPHONE DUO 2 MAY GET FACE ID
